name: scale_tree
description: Carboniferous scale tree (Lepidodendron): tall straight brown trunk (#6b5a3a) covered in a bold diamond leaf-scar pattern, spreading root lobes at the base, twice-forked branches at the top ending in dense grassy green leaf tufts (#4f8a3a). Anchor bottom-centre. ~300x800 (x -150..+150, y ~-800..0). Also works rotated 80-85 as a fallen trunk.
